log.summary: A box of turquoise animal figurines was in the white dragon hoard. Ord inspected them and left them behind. Sylan thinks they might turn into creatures.
notes: A box of them was in the white dragon hoard. Ord inspected them and left them behind. Sylan thinks they might turn into creatures.

log.summary: Ord holds the turquoise animal figurines, though their function remains unknown. Ord believes they originated from the Sunder Chase, making it unlikely they are connected to the lich or serve as its phylactery. Sylan suggests they might come to life when activated by a magic word or inscription, similar to the shark statuette.
